 The announcement marks the end of two fan-favorite pairings that helped shape GMMTV's current BL era.
 BL fans are saying goodbye to two beloved pairings after GMMTV announced that Joong Archen Aydin and Dunk Natachai Boonprasert , as well as Aou Thanaboon Kiatniran and Boom Tharatorn Jantharaworakarn, have mutually agreed to conclude their activities as official pairs.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by GMMTV (@gmmtv) 
 The announcement quickly spread across social media, with many fans describing the news as "April Fools?" and "Prank ba to?" for the two pairings that have become staples of GMMTV's BL roster.
 Screenshot from GMMTV's FB post 
 For many netizens, the announcement signals the end of an era. Joong and Dunk became one of GMMTV's most recognizable BL pairings through projects such as Star in My Mind , Hidden Agenda and The Heart Killers building a loyal fanbase in Thailand and overseas.
 RELATED: #GMAHOAAccess: All the fun scenes at 'The Heart Killers' fan meet 
 Meanwhile, Aou and Boom steadily gained popularity through their appearances in series including We Are, Hidden Agenda, and Perfect 10 Liners, earning praise for their natural chemistry and fan interactions.
 While fans are understandably emotional over the development, many have expressed support for the actors' decision and their future endeavors.

 Though the pairings may have come to an end, the memories, characters, and moments that JoongDunk and AouBoom shared with fans will continue to hold a special place in BL fandom.
